_comment: ORGANISER ONLY until released. Hints narrow the conceptual search space without naming papers, the number of transitions or the application. The organiser releases them from the console; released hints are recorded in data/submissions/hint_state.json.

hints.text: Investigate how different disciplines reconstruct relationships or structures from incomplete observations.
Look for mathematical or computational methods that represent branching, evolving, or partially observed relationships.
Investigate how methods for inferring hidden structures from indirect observations can be used across otherwise unrelated domains.
When you think you have found the shared idea, ask where it runs every day outside research: which widely used tool would stop working if that idea were wrong?
